composition_summary: Offline full-v3 export only. The requested class-21 Recipe draft is emitted with the exact supplied constructor keys (name, description, trigger, steps, prior_knowledge_content, intent_examples, step_descriptions, variants, dependency_registry), trigger=null, steps=[], dependency_registry=null, one desc_idx=0 with a single persisted step using the knowledge/stepnumber/type=component/include schema and the two supplied UUIDs in order (ToolSkill 2e335c7f-8081-53a6-aa2d-2aede7926726 then PythonCode cc52df93-9358-5238-9317-23fea95aa6ef), tool_bindings=[], dependencies=null, and one variant with step_link=0:1-0:E, variable_patterns=[], and ten distinct intent examples. This subworkflow posts exactly the fixed word 'Idle' as a user reply using the bound existing host.post_reply Tool. The draft is unapproved: it carries no version numbers or approval, and activation/reuse requires Q1 and human Q2. The current offline sink cannot preserve the full v3 field set (it drops step_descriptions, variants and dependency_registry), so this is a design export, not a live insert; typed inputs remain a target interface, not deployed runtime support. The original conversation is preserved unchanged and all compatibility arrays are empty under the test persona.
